concept: A working schematic wall: documents, agents, and finished lessons exist as engineered symbols wired together by visible connector lines, like a systems diagram that has come alive.
material: engineered schematic — flat Fluent iconography on a clean cool-white ground, connected by hairline paths, never glassy or glowing
motionSignature: Drafting-line: icons and connectors self-draw or spring into their wired position, then settle with a smooth long-tail ease; nothing floats or breathes independently; camera holds static or performs one motivated push per scene.
composition: Full-width process rails and asymmetric constellations; type is heavy sentence-case Montserrat anchored to an edge; content stays in the top 83% for caption safety; at least 45% of each frame stays open.
signatureMotif: A single hairline connector path that redraws once per scene to link the previous idea to the next; it is connective tissue, not the hero, and never repeats in two adjacent scenes as the dominant visual.

sceneTreatments.s1-hook: kinetic-type word build over an unfolding document icon (hand-stitched)
sceneTreatments.s2-factory: constellation hub — three source icons wire into one central factory mark (hand-stitched)
sceneTreatments.s3-agents: state-mutation checklist — agent icon inspects a document, checkmarks resolve in sequence (hand-stitched)
sceneTreatments.s4-production: full-width process rail — three stage icons assemble left to right (hand-stitched)
sceneTreatments.s5-render: traveling connector — a path draws through three quality-check icons (hand-stitched)
sceneTreatments.s6-outcome: compress-then-expand field — pipeline loop shrinks, then a small field of lesson icons reaches team icons (hand-stitched)
sceneTreatments.s7-endcard: still title lockup, single reveal, held (restrained close — no motif, no motion after reveal)
